reasons.vendor:
EVE-NG vjunosswitch.yml pins a much more specific CPU than a plain model
name: "-cpu IvyBridge,ibpb=on,md-clear=on,spec-ctrl=on,ssbd=on,vmx=on".
netplex's cpu_model field only carries a base model name (qemu.py's
<model fallback='forbid'>{model}</model> - no per-flag passthrough for a
profile-level pin), so the base model (IvyBridge, a real QEMU CPU model)
is set here and the extra security/virtualization feature flags are
named here rather than silently dropped - a real, disclosed schema
limitation (rule #31), not an oversight.
